parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule_chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, and first_approval. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records as an inner join to enforce the at-least-one-record requirement. Left join compound_structures to include canonical_smiles for molecules that have structures while retaining those without. Filter molecule_dictionary where max_phase is 3 or 4. Sort by molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, max_phase, and first_approval.
